summary_markdown: Discussion regarding the availability of directional markers on the production environment, specifically for displaying data related to Finland using Rembol data. [p6] confirmed that directional markers exist in principle for one-way roads. However, [p5] noted that the necessary information regarding whether a road is one-way was not received from the source (Rembol). It was suggested that typically, if a road is one-way, the first point represents the start and the last point represents the end to determine direction.
action_items: Determine how to handle directional data for Finland using Rembol input.
